title: A busy (leased) singleton is classified busy, not absent
retires: F-CLASS-08 busy/absent misclassification (classification half; the bounded-wait half is F-CLASS-28; the evaluator_gate wait policy is pending_lane_1)
notes: GREEN: the singleton is busy (leased) -> rejection reason is state-specific ('leased'), distinct from absence. RED: instead of being busy, the operator is absent (disabled) -> reason becomes 'disabled' -> the 'contains leased' and 'not_contains disabled' checks both fail. This exercises the busy!=absent classification that the corpus records as the root of F-CLASS-08's wrong human-review cascade.
